name: staged_capex_working_capital_timing_npv
question_template: A plant is built in two stages: capex of USD {C1} at time zero and USD {C2} at the beginning of year 2. The beginning of year t is the same instant as the end of year t-1; time zero is the beginning of year 1. Operating inflows arrive at each year-end for {N} years: USD {F} in year 1, then changing {G} percent per year (negative means decline). Working capital must equal {W} percent of the coming year's inflow, set at the beginning of that year; each adjustment is the change from the prior balance (zero before year 1), an increase being an outflow and a decrease a release at that instant. At the end of year {N}, {REC} percent of the final balance is recovered and the rest is lost. The annual discount rate is {R} percent. Compute the project NPV at time zero.

slots.description: Present value of both capex stages combined.
Total present value of all end-of-year operating inflows.
Net present value of beginning-of-year working-capital adjustments, positive meaning net outflow.
Present value of the recovered working capital at project end.

program:
def solve():
    C1 = Fraction(P["C1"])
    C2 = Fraction(P["C2"])
    F = Fraction(P["F"])
    g = Fraction(P["G"]) / 100
    w = Fraction(P["W"]) / 100
    N = int(P["N"])
    rec = Fraction(P["REC"]) / 100
    r = Fraction(P["R"]) / 100
    d = 1 + r
    pv_capex = C1 + C2 / d
    pv_inflows = Fraction(0)
    pv_wc_adj = Fraction(0)
    prev = Fraction(0)
    for t in range(1, N + 1):
        inflow = F * (1 + g) ** (t - 1)
        pv_inflows += inflow / d ** t
        req = w * inflow
        adj = req - prev
        pv_wc_adj += adj / d ** (t - 1)
        prev = req
    pv_release = rec * prev / d ** N
    npv = pv_inflows - pv_capex - pv_wc_adj + pv_release
    return {
        "final": npv,
        "pv_staged_capex": pv_capex,
        "pv_operating_inflows": pv_inflows,
        "pv_wc_adjustments": pv_wc_adj,
        "pv_wc_release": pv_release,
    }
